answer: Watermark bonds. Each agent posts a 400-credit bond whose hash carries a one-time watermark from a salt in its key store. The watermark rides inside the signal of every signed transaction, invisible to peers, recoverable by the ledger. When a clone cluster surfaces, the watermark bridges each cloned signature to its seed, forfeiting the bond plus 40 credits per linked clone. Fifty clones cost the attacker 400 + 2,000 = 2,400 credits against ~30 per clone per epoch. A weaver dyeing one saffron strand into every rope: the cloth passes a hundred hands, yet the dye betrays the loom.
